name: keel-demo-video
description: Keel's demo video, made in code: Playwright captures the app, Remotion animates, numpy/scipy synthesize the sound, FFmpeg exports.

scripts.export: ffmpeg -y -i out/keel-raw.mp4 -i public/audio/score.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p -profile:v high -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest -movflags +faststart out/keel-demo.mp4
